# Weston-Yamada As a [bold]We-Ya Communications Executive[/bold] you answer faxes on behalf of the Weston-Yamada Communications Division, from Orbital Communications Platform 583. Your main contact is the [bold]Corporate Liaison[/bold] aboard the [italic]Almayer[/italic].
Everything on the [textlink="Fax Responders" link="RMCRulesFaxResponder"] page still applies. This page only covers what is specific to We-Ya.
[bold][color=#ff6b6b]We-Ya rules[/color][/bold] - You may [bold]not[/bold] authorize a WeYa PMC deployment. Always AHELP such requests. - You are a professional, but [bold]not[/bold] a manager or director. You are very much under the same thumb as the CL, not a lord or lady. - Keep your contact between the CL and yourself only. Consider any communication [bold]highly confidential[/bold]. - If a CL faxes anything antagonistic, or anything that could be considered high sedition, AHELP [bold]immediately[/bold], and thereafter inform the MPs via fax. - Do not send the CL entire books. They are in a round and with an Executive Bodyguard. If you make communications a labour for CLs to deal with, you will ruin responding for everyone else.
## Your Character At the end of the day, you can go about your roleplay however you see fit. Some people pretend they had zero clue about xenonids; some pretend guilt.
You're not omnipotent, and you rely on the CL to find things out. Remember you're just a lowly We-Ya employee, just like them. You can be as surprised as they are, or as worried for We-Ya's PR.
You're also a character in the setting, who only really knows as much as your manager would tell you.
## Fax Ideas These are a few ideas you can present directly as [italic]"The director wants you to..."[/italic]
Anything else, assume you are working on behalf of an admin's character. For anything wildly outside this scope, [bold]contact an admin[/bold].
- Collect materials or data from the colony. - Conduct interviews with survivors or station personnel, strictly specifying what information you're after. - Request NDAs from involved parties. - Help newer players with worldbuilding. - Provide remote legal support. - Try reputational damage control.
## Your Equipment - [bold]Reply template:[/bold] a pre-formatted We-Ya fax in your satchel. Base every reply on it so all We-Ya faxes look the same. - [bold]Stamp:[/bold] the Weston-Yamada stamp is what makes a fax authentic. Stamp every reply.
